App details

Voice Recorder

Record speech, notes and interviews, then organize and share your recordings.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Local audio recording in M4A/AAC, MP3 or WAV, with quality profiles, waveform and markers, plus pause/resume and background recording.

Main features

  • Pause and continue the same recording.
  • Name recordings, add tags and search them.
  • Add markers to find important moments.
  • Background recording and selectable quality.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Recording, playback, markers and organisation

Record, pause, resume and save

Allow microphone access and start recording deliberately. Pause adds no new sound; Resume continues the same recording. Stop closes and saves the file. A live waveform, input level and overload warning help judge capture. A write or capture error is shown instead of claiming a successful recording.

Formats, profiles and input selection

Choose Speech/Small, Normal, High Quality or Custom settings. Planned formats are M4A/AAC, MP3 and WAV/PCM, offered only with reliable device support; WAV is lossless and larger. Mono/stereo and selectable microphones depend on available hardware. Custom bitrate, sample rate and channels must form a supported combination.

Markers, names, tags and playback

Add a named marker while recording or paused, then jump to it during playback. Rename or remove markers without changing the sound. Name and tag recordings, search by either, and browse duration/date/format/file size. Playback offers play, pause and seeking; export or share the chosen recording through Android.

Screen-off recording and interruption handling

A recording you start can continue with the screen off or app in the background, with visible recording notification where required. Use notification Stop, or supported Pause/Resume controls. Calls, input loss and low storage produce an explicit pause/stop or error. Previously written sound may be recoverable, with partial files clearly labelled; recovery is not guaranteed.

Local recordings and your sharing choices

Sound stays on the device unless you export or share it yourself. Microphone capture is tied to your explicit recording and visible state; there is no call recording or hidden surveillance. Stored files, names, tags and markers remain available for your own playback and organisation.

The tangled cassette

Tap the About logo seven times for a drawn analogue cassette whose reels turn until its tape tangles. The offline joke suggests going digital. It uses no microphone and leaves your real recordings unchanged.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All described functions are planned to be free, with banner ads and optional one-time Google Play ad removal. No subscription is planned. The purchase screen shows the actual local price; purchase restoration uses Google Play.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
